evals.prompt: Build a Pinterest affiliate campaign for a beginner balcony herb-gardening niche around the topic small balcony herb garden. Include the keyword brief, a useful article outline and draft, five pin variants, visual briefs, disclosures, and three monetization options. Do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: A complete eight-stage campaign with clearly labeled estimates, five distinct pins under 100 characters, full URLs only when supplied, and no invented trend data.

evals.prompt: I want to use Pinterest affiliate links for home organization, but I have no trend data, article URL, or affiliate product yet. Tell me what you need and give me a safe first-step plan without pretending you validated a trend.
evals.expected_output: Requests only necessary missing inputs, labels trend validation as pending, and avoids claiming Pinterest or FTC rules without checking current sources.

evals.prompt: Turn this article topic into five Pinterest pins: budget meal prep for two. Use https://example.com/budget-meal-prep and a placeholder affiliate product called Meal Prep Containers. Include titles, descriptions, full URL, board, alt text, visual brief, and disclosure.
